system: Illustrative RCC frame and clay-brick masonry infill; not a confirmed structural-system choice

nativeWalls.source: Original native wall meshes/opening voids and CAD-derived plan section faces

dimensionalFindings.meaning: Geometric conflicts of EXAMPLE members, not load/strength analysis or a request to alter approved walls/vents.
dimensionalFindings.diagnostics: Actual intersecting boxes and original apertures remain outlined, including when walls are cut/hidden.
dimensionalFindings.unresolved: Monitor/hip transfers, full open hall span, internal gravity/lateral system, slab/foundations/soil, lintels/ties and joints; no guessed supports in the passage.

validation.command: node --test structural-concept.test.mjs navigation.test.mjs wall-sections.test.mjs furnishings.test.mjs lamp-controls.test.mjs door-presentation.test.mjs site.test.mjs validate-deployment.test.mjs
validation.targeted: Seven structural and four lamp tests: real mm/member bounds, column-face beam joints, exact native walls/slab, all six geometric vent clashes and changed-section recomputation, preserved open passage, datum translation, explicit invalid inputs, occlusion/gesture/nearest-visible keyboard selection.
browserChecks: Solid study and wall/roof references isolated from normal modes.
Cut walls and full walls change only the display clip and native caps.
Frame-only mode retains clash markers; cut action disables when walls hidden.
Roof outline toggles without creating a roof slab.
Exterior roof/furniture preferences, selected radio and focus handling preserved.
Interior starts collision-clear and Fly returns to safe walking.
No upfront Lamps panel, discovery prompt or hidden dashboard switch buttons.
Synthetic mouse/touch pointer sequences on actual projected lamp mesh toggle it; dragging is rejected.
Scene-focused L switches nearest visible lamp; independent state survives hidden furniture and mode restoration.
validation.pointerTestLimit: DOM pointer-sequence exercise with orbit disabled for synthetic pointer capture; not a physical touch-device test. The browser element-click helper dispatches click without the required pointer sequence, so it was not treated as proof of direct lamp tapping.
validation.responsiveAssertions: All20 cases: no horizontal overflow; all visible buttons >=44px; concept warning only in Structure; lamp panel absent.

budget.limits: Actual responsive browser renders, not a physical low-end-phone/FPS benchmark. Materials are generic authored textures, not photogrammetric realism.

reviewImages.note: Saved WebGL renders have explicit non-engineered/example labels. The mobile image is a rendered viewport, not a full-page UI screenshot.

references.use: RC-frame/masonry-infill system explanation and need for an engineered complete system; not section sizing.
Infill/window interaction and explicit distinction between a view cut and proposed partial-height walls.
Manufacturer's 230 x110 x75mm clay-brick material scale; no product performance/suitability claim.

assetLicense: All new concrete/clay/mortar maps and geometry are locally authored. No reference photos, copied drawings, commercial meshes or externally hosted runtime assets.
delivery: Local feature only. No merge, push or PR authorized/performed.
